## Description

Brief description of the changes.

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Refactoring (no functional changes)

## Testing

- [ ] All tests pass (`pytest test/ -v`)
- [ ] New tests added for new functionality
- [ ] Code coverage maintained or improved
- [ ] Self-test passes (`figtreekit --self-test`)

## Checklist

- [ ] Code follows PEP 8 style guidelines (line length 100)
- [ ] Self-review of code completed
- [ ] Docstrings added/updated (Google style)
- [ ] Type hints added for public methods
- [ ] Documentation updated (README_CN.md, README_EN.md, user manuals)
- [ ] No new linting errors (`flake8 figtreekit/ --max-line-length=100`)
